# exodus Provider

Manages servers, SSH keys, firewalls and VPC networks on [exodus.host](https://exodus.host). Authenticate with a project API token created in the panel under «API-токены»; the provider works in that token's project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    exodus = {
      source = "exodushost/exodus"
    }
  }
}

# The token comes from the EXODUS_TOKEN environment variable.
# Create one in the exodus.host panel under «API-токены».
provider "exodus" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) API base URL. Defaults to `https://exodus.host/api/v1`, or the `EXODUS_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API token (`exo_…`). Can also be set with the `EXODUS_TOKEN` environment variable.
